assets.alt: The sandbag filling fixture is upside down with its three pipes pointing upward.
assets.caption: Invert the fixture.

assets.creator: La Habra Heights Fire Watch handout contributors
assets.alt: One empty sandbag is pulled over each of the fixture's three upright pipes.
assets.caption: Put a sandbag on each pipe.

assets.creator: La Habra Heights Fire Watch handout contributors
assets.alt: The fixture has been turned right side up, with one empty bag hanging beneath each opening.
assets.caption: Turn the fixture right side up.

assets.creator: La Habra Heights Fire Watch handout contributors
assets.alt: Sand fills all three fixture openings to the top while the bags hang below.
assets.caption: Fill to the top with sand.

assets.creator: La Habra Heights Fire Watch handout contributors
assets.alt: Two gloved hands lift the fixture straight upward while three filled sandbags remain on the ground.
assets.caption: Lift the fixture and leave the sand in the bags.

assets.creator: La Habra Heights Fire Watch handout contributors
assets.alt: The fixture is set upside down with its pipes upright beside the filled bags, ready for another batch.
assets.caption: Reset the fixture for more sandbags.

assets.creator: La Habra Heights Fire Watch handout contributors
assets.alt: Four completed sandbags have been moved into a line away from the filling fixture.
assets.caption: Move completed sandbags away from the work area.

assets.creator: La Habra Heights Fire Watch handout contributors
assets.alt: Plan view: runoff approaches a house from the uphill side; a short angled sandbag line steers it toward an existing safe drainage path, leaving the doorway and exit clear.
assets.caption: Choose a short route to safe drainage.

assets.creator: La Habra Heights Fire Watch handout contributors
assets.alt: Top view shows overlapping bags with folded ends facing incoming runoff; section view shows a wider base under a staggered second layer.
assets.caption: Overlap and stagger bags.

assets.creator: Mark Hughes
assets.alt: Place sandbags parallel to running water to help prevent overtopping
assets.caption: Place sandbags parallel to running water to help prevent overtopping
